title: Simple Mention
description: Simple mention allow users to mention other players in chat using @username syntax.
body:
**Simple Mention: Never Miss a Message Again!** Tired of important messages getting lost in the chat chaos? **Simple Mention** is here to bring clarity to your conversations! This lightweight mod allows players to **mention each other directly in chat** using the familiar `@username` syntax, ensuring your message stands out and gets noticed. --- ### ✨ What Does It Do? * **Effortless Mentions (Server-Side Logic):** Simply type `@` followed by a player's username (e.g., `@Hezaerd`) in chat to mention them. The core logic for detecting mentions and alerting players runs on the server, ensuring everyone benefits from this feature. * **Enhanced Client Experience (Optional):** Installing Simple Mention on your client unlocks additional features! * **Autocomplete Suggestions:** Easily find and select player names as you type `@`. * **Desktop Notifications:** Receive a system notification when you are mentioned when Minecraft isn't in focus, so you never miss a call-out. * **Customizable Highlights:** Players who are mentioned will see their name highlighted in chat. This feature is designed to be subtle yet effective, ensuring you catch relevant messages without being intrusive. * **Lightweight and Compatible:** Built to be as minimal as possible, Simple Mention is designed to be highly compatible with other Fabric mods and won't weigh down your game. --- ### Why This Mod? This mod was originally built for my modded server, but I like open source and the modding community, so I wanted to share it with the world. If you frequently play on multiplayer servers or with friends and want a straightforward way to get someone's attention in chat, Simple Mention is the perfect solution. Improve your communication and ensure your messages are heard! --- ### ⚙️ How to Install: * Make sure you have [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) installed. * This mod is built for Minecraft **1.20.1**. * Download the `.jar` file and place it into your Minecraft `mods` folder. * **For full functionality (mentions, autocomplete, notifications), install on both your server and client.** * **Dependencies:** * [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) * [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)
